description: This file implements a versatile Least Recently Used (LRU) cache class with support for TTL (time-to-live), size constraints, background fetches, and deprecation warnings. It also includes polyfills for AbortController and AbortSignal to ensure compatibility across environments. The class provides methods for adding, retrieving, deleting, and managing cache entries efficiently, making it a core component for cache management in JavaScript applications.

classes.name: AbortController
classes.description: Polyfill class for AbortController to support aborting fetch requests or other asynchronous operations.

classes.name: AbortSignal
classes.description: Polyfill class for AbortSignal to handle abort events and listeners.

classes.name: LRUCache
classes.description: Main class implementing an optimized LRU cache with TTL, size constraints, and fetch support.

classes.name: Stack
classes.description: Helper class implementing a basic stack data structure, used internally for managing free list indices.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Add or update cache entries with support for TTL, size, and status callback.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve cache entries, optionally respecting TTL and staleness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Remove a cache entry by key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear all entries from the cache.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Remove the least recently used item, used internally to enforce max size.

methods.name: backgroundFetch
methods.description: Perform background fetch operation with support for abort and error handling.
